core_meaning.primary_meaning: Fatoumata is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Fatima (West African form)”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Fatoumata corresponds to the Arabic form فَاطِمَة (Arabic root ف ط م (f-ṭ-m); فَاطِمَة (Fāṭima)). Its core sense is fatoumata; fatima (west african form). Fatoumata is the West African (Fulani) form of Arabic فَاطِمَة (Fāṭima), the name of the Prophet's daughter.

persian.name: فاطمه
